0.why: the pitch output carries one, four or eight channels according to the play mode, per the manual's outputs table

2.why: velocity 0-127 mapped linearly onto 0-10V, per the manual's MIDI conventions

3.why: a controller value of 0-127 mapped onto 0-10V, per the manual's CC output table

comment: ONE has no parameters and no inputs, so the only things to click for help are its jacks. Its MULTI expander goes immediately to the right. The eight controller outputs are assigned by controller number rather than per MIDI channel, so any matching message that passes the Rack MIDI filter updates them.
